title: Schedule vs Actual Time Discrepancy Detection

blueprintSignals.name: Punch-to-schedule delta
blueprintSignals.definition: minutes between scheduled and actual start and end
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use punch time not the entry time

blueprintSignals.name: Edit history
blueprintSignals.definition: number and recency of manual edits to a record
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use only edits logged before scoring

blueprintSignals.name: Duplicate signature
blueprintSignals.definition: same person with overlapping or near-identical entries
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Match on pseudonymous ID and time window

blueprintSignals.name: Approval gap
blueprintSignals.definition: worked hours beyond schedule without a recorded approval
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Approval records as of the cut-off

label: For "Schedule vs Actual Time Discrepancy Detection": Identify missed punches, schedule deviations, unapproved overtime, duplicate time entries and reconciliation exceptions before payroll closes, with a supporting timeline and a documented correction path. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on already-corrected data.
